…into a tailspin with no warning, no help, and,  frankly, no concern.

Maybe that is the point. Republicans don't care about new small  business entrepreneurs or those people struggling with opioid  addiction. If the majority did, my colleagues on the other side of the  aisle would uplift successful programs and agencies like SBA or SAMHSA,  not gut…

…stringent requirements for renewable energy: California,  New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Connecticut. That is where energy  costs have gone up the most. That is where people are struggling the  most to pay their energy bills.
